description: Only the exact next sequence and verified predecessor may commit.
Verify committed content and intended routing before every effect.
Integrity failures quarantine, clear context, and prevent effects.
Bound queue, payload bytes, session count, and immutable record admission.
Availability failure yields HOLD without granting trust or alleging tampering.
Diagnostic eviction never removes committed verification identities.
Capture immutable verified inputs before any suspension.
Apply bounded stream backpressure and own source cleanup without effect retries.
Shutdown and cancellation have one cleanup owner and settle resources.
Enforce explicit structural and semantic branch complexity budgets.
Validate the actual MCP wire contract without numeric coercion.
Measure speed and memory under declared environment-scoped budgets.
Retain reproducible assertions, failures, and requirement-preserving supersession.
